author: Parsifal-2045
body: #### PR description: This PR improves the existing heterogeneous Broken Line fit, removing some of the hard-coded assumptions used for Run 3, therefore significantly improving the track parameter estimation for all CA tracks. A new boolean `useFitCorrections` in `CAHitNtupletAlpaka` controls whether to use the baseline version of the fit (False) or enable the new corrections (True) for any CA producer. The corrections are enabled by default for the vector-hits CA, since the addition of outer-tracker hits in a model meant to fit short PixelSeeds in Run 3 produced significant biases, solved by the corrections. When the corrections are enabled, the fit improves in a few main areas: - **Material:** The Run 3 fit relied on a single parameter for the average Pixel density. With the corrections, the fit reads a phi-integrated r,z map of the tracker and beam-pipe material, made from the Geant4 simulation of the tracker (new ES producer `BLMaterialMapESProducerAlpaka`, data in cms-data) along the track between every pair of fitted hits. - **Multiple scattering:** the assumption on maximum pT is removed, and the multiple scattering follows Highland's formula on the material that the track crossed from the beam line (assuming pion mass) - **Energy loss:** added as a new correction to the curvature (there is no energy loss term without the corrections). - **Magnetic field:** a map of Bz and Br (new ES producer `BLBFieldMapESProducerAlpaka`, made from the `MagneticField` once per IOV). The fit uses the field along the track, rather than the constant field at the origin - **Outer-tracker hits:** the fit moves each hit along its strip to the position that the track predicts. It combines the two sensors of each vector hit, and it adds to the curvature the change from the scattering kinks of the dip angle. A few changes / fixes are general and not gated by the new flag: - Two covariance fixes, in `riemannFit::transformToPerigeePlane` and in `translateKarimaki`. The covariance changes on all topologies, Run 3 included (so minor changes might show up in Run 3 workflows) - The BL fit kernels are not launched per-number-of-hits anymore, there is a single fused kernel fitting tracks from 4 to 10 hits (vector hits). This also removes the `fitNas4` parameter. `customizeHLTforBLFitCorrections` removes it from Run 3 menus. A presentation for the changes introduced by this PR is scheduled for the 16/11 TRK POG meeting ([link](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1753242/#15-updated-broken-line-fit)) This PR also includes the code to read and re-generate the new material maps used by the corrected BL fit. Maps have been generated for all currently supported tracking geometries (from T35 to T38), and the correct map is automatically selected at runtime, with an exception if the match is incorrect or the correct map cannot be found. #### PR validation: Code compiles and runs. There is no significant change in efficiency / fakes for the vector-hits CA, while pulls and resolutions are significantly improved: effic vs eta | fake rate vs eta |:----------:|:----------:| | effic vs pT | pT resolution |:----------:|:----------:| | pT pull vs eta Mean (%) | pT pull vs eta sigma |:----------:|:----------:| | All plots are available [here](https://lferragi.web.cern.ch/plots/tracking_phase2/itaca/blFit/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-09-2300/). **Note**: this PR includes https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52492, which should be merged first, and this PR rebased on top. It also needs to be tested with https://github.com/cms-data/RecoTracker-PixelSeeding/pull/2
title: Add material and B-field corrections to the alpaka BrokenLine fit, and enable them for the Phase-2 vector-hits CA
